data.title: fal Acquires Lucent, Welcomes Co-Founders Dimi Panagiotopoulos and Alex Koumpas to the team
data.description: In a recent development, Fal has successfully purchased Lucent, an innovative AI agent-based platform specializing in creative media. This acquisition includes bringing on board the two founders of Lucent, in line with Fal's strategy to support and invest in emerging talents driving advancements in generative media. The transaction was confirmed on September 14, 2026, in San Francisco. It signifies Fal's commitment to fostering creativity and innovation in the industry, aligning with its vision for the future.

data.title: Payment Nerds Secures $2 Million Credit Facility from Espresso Capital to Accelerate Growth
data.description: In Nashville, Tennessee on September 14, 2026, Payment Nerds, a company specializing in merchant services and payment processing, disclosed receiving a $2 million credit facility from Espresso Capital. The financial boost will bolster the company's growth efforts and facilitate its expansion endeavors.

data.title: InventHelp Inventor Develops Disposable Plate Dispenser (CLR-373)
data.description: A new invention called DISH-SPENSE has been created by an inventor from Park Forest, Ill. The product aims to dispense one disposable plate at a time during events like picnics and parties. The idea behind this design is to eliminate the need for guests to touch multiple plates. This invention is seen as a convenient solution for events, ensuring hygiene and ease of use. The inventor's innovation is set to transform the way plates are handled, making event planning more streamlined.

data.title: Jamf Announces Same-Day Support For macOS Golden Gate 27, iOS 27 And Other OS 27 Releases
data.description: Minneapolis-based Jamf, a leading provider of Apple device management and security solutions for businesses, has announced immediate support for Apple's latest software updates. This includes macOS Golden Gate 27, iOS 27, iPadOS 27, tvOS 27, visionOS 27, and watchOS 27, all of which were officially released today. Jamf's swift response ensures that businesses can seamlessly transition to the new Apple operating systems without disruptions. By conducting thorough testing during Apple's beta phase, Jamf guarantees full compatibility with all the latest releases for a smooth user experience.

data.title: Persona Joins Internet2 to Strengthen Identity Security Across Research and Higher Education
data.description: In San Francisco today, Persona, a reputable verified identity platform, revealed its inclusion in Internet2's NET+ program. This advanced technology nonprofit serves the research and education sector. Through this partnership, Persona's identity verification technology will be accessible to a broader range of colleges and universities. This will enhance their ability to securely verify the identities of students, faculty, staff, and others. Identity fraud remains a significant challenge, and this collaboration aims to address this issue effectively.

data.title: Backswing Ventures: What Mach Industries' $3.7 Billion Valuation Says About the Defense Tech Hype Cycle
data.description: In the year 2026, funding for defense technology has reached unprecedented levels, with a notable increase in investment. Backswing Ventures emphasizes that the significant figure to focus on is not the valuation stated on a term sheet, but rather the actual cash that investors receive in return. This development was highlighted in Orlando, Florida on September 14, 2026. A specific example includes Mach Industries, which saw its valuation soar to $3.7 million.

data.title: National GED Day Celebrates Graduates Taking the Next Step Toward College and Careers
data.description: On September 16th, the annual National GED Day will be celebrated by GED Testing Service®, acknowledging the accomplishments of adult learners and the valuable opportunities they bring to their families and communities. This day highlights the achievements made by individuals striving for success through education.

data.title: "The Healer's Journey" Explores the Hidden Toll of Caring for Others
data.description: In her novel, Faith Grayson explores the journey of an emergency physician as they address vicarious trauma with the help of travel, introspection, and faith. This book, titled Recognition, is the initial installment in a series of four books aimed at healing and rejuvenation. The story is set in Phoenix and was released on September 14, 2026.

data.title: César Acuña Núñez brings a vision of education, technology, and inclusion for a new generation to the United Nations
data.description: A delegate from Peru's government served as a speaker for César Vallejo University (UCV) during the 20th International Human Rights Summit at the United Nations. The summit, held in New York City, focused on discussing the impact of education and artificial intelligence in enhancing opportunities and reducing societal inequalities.

data.title: Your Muscles May Be One of Your Most Valuable Retirement Assets
data.description: Co-founders of Fitness & Finance emphasize the importance of incorporating muscle preservation into retirement planning discussions. In a recent discussion in Fredericksburg, Virginia on September 14, 2026, they shed light on the fact that many individuals primarily concentrate on determining their savings amounts and investment strategies for retirement. However, they highlighted that muscle mass also plays a crucial role in retirement planning.

data.title: PolicyMe: Family Well-Being Leads Life Insurance Priorities for Canadians
data.description: In a recent analysis, it was discovered that 42.0% of individuals seeking life insurance prioritize family well-being. Another study revealed that the most common coverage amount applied for and sold was $500,000. The data was from PolicyMe customer interactions in Toronto on September 14, 2026.

data.title: Leading Health Organizations Unite in Washington to Celebrate Health Leadership and Launch the National Hispanic Health Foundation Action Fund
data.description: On 14th September 2026, Washington will witness a collaborative event involving the National Hispanic Health Foundation (NHHF), National Minority Quality Forum (NMQF), Association of American Medical Colleges (AAMC), and National Hispanic Medical Association (NHMA). Set to take place on 16th September, this event symbolizes a significant gathering in the healthcare sector for the year 2026.

data.title: VIP Announces Strategic Acquisition of Encompass Technologies to Accelerate the Future of Food & Beverage Technology
data.description: A recent acquisition by VIP, a prominent technology partner in the food and beverage sector, has widened its reach in technology access and sped up AI advancements within the industry. The acquisition of Encompass, finalized on September 14, 2026, in Colchester, Vt., marks a significant milestone. VIP is now in a stronger position to drive innovation, enhance services, and meet the growing demands of the sector. This move will undoubtedly have a positive impact, further solidifying VIP's standing in the market and setting the stage for exciting developments.

data.title: InventHelp Inventor Develops Collapsable Infant Car Seat (CHK-6023)
data.description: In Pittsburgh on September 14, 2026, an inventor from North Aurora, Illinois shared their motivation behind creating a collapsible infant car seat for convenient transportation through airports and parking lots. The inventor highlighted the design innovation aimed at eliminating the necessity to check the seat during travels. The collapsible infant car seat is envisioned to offer ease of use and portability, revolutionizing traditional car seat designs.

data.title: PHFA issues RFP for PHARE funding to support local housing initiatives
data.description: The Pennsylvania Housing Finance Agency has released a Request for Proposals on September 14, 2026, with an application deadline of November 19th. The initiative aims to increase access to affordable housing and support housing-related projects. This funding opportunity seeks to address crucial housing needs in Pennsylvania, offering a chance for organizations to contribute to these efforts. Interested parties should submit their proposals before the November 19 deadline to be considered for funding.
